snippet.title: Dark Souls: Nightfall (MOD) -- Release Date Teaser
snippet.description:
Dark Souls: Nightfall is a direct, fan-made sequel to Dark Souls in the form of a mod. It contains a new story, new combat system, new world map, and more.

NOTE: Nightfall's release has been delayed until early 2023, but we're working hard on it!

Not affiliated with Bandai Namco or FromSoftware.

You can support the work of Meowmaritus and Grimrukh on Patreon!
https://patreon.com/Meowmaritus
https://patreon.com/Grimrukh
----------------
Team Nightfall is:

[ AinTunez ---- Has the Money ]
Project Management, Framework Design, Voice Direction, Music
https://twitter.com/AinTunez 

[ Grimrukh ---- Has the Vision ]
Main Quest Design, World Design, Maps, Events, Writing
https://twitter.com/Grimrukh

[ Meowmaritus ---- Has the Drive ]
Combat, Animation, VFX, AI, Sound Effects, ASM Hacks
https://twitter.com/Meowmaritus

[ horkrux --- Has the Patience ]

[ Dane Brennand (aka SiriusTexra) ---- Has the Actual Souls Game Credits ]
3D Art, 2D Art, Writing

[ wulf2k ---- Has the Wife and Kids ]
Framework Design, ASM Hacks

[ Souv ---- Has the Painting Skills ]
2D Art

[ ZullieTheWitch ---- Eats Humanity for Breakfast ]
Writing, Sidequest Design
